title: Reynard: A real Firefox web browser for iOS 13 or later
summary: Reynard is an open-source web browser for iOS 13+ that implements the actual Firefox browser engine, making it a 'real' browser rather than just a UI wrapper around WebKit, using GeckoView for rendering.
problem_solved: Provides iOS users with an alternative to Safari and Chrome by bringing Firefox's Gecko rendering engine to the iOS platform.
why_valuable: It gives users and developers a genuine Firefox experience on iOS with open-source transparency, enabling web compatibility testing across different rendering engines on mobile.
